Based on the provided authoritative legal context for Financial Year 2024-25 (Assessment Year 2025-26), here is the analysis regarding the standard deduction for salaried individuals under the New Tax Regime:

**Standard Deduction under Section 16(ia) in the New Tax Regime**

*   **Applicable Amount:** For a taxpayer being an employee who has selected the New Tax Regime under Section 115BAC, the standard deduction under Section 16(ia) can be claimed only to the extent of **Rs. 75,000** [C1].
*   **Regime Specificity:** This limit of Rs. 75,000 is explicitly applicable in the case of the New Tax Regime [C1].
*   **Contrast with Old Regime:** In contrast, under the Old Tax Regime, the standard deduction under Section 16(ia) is restricted to Rs. 50,000 or the salary, whichever is less [C5].

**Note on Context Grounding:**
